de: „Muss man morgens gießen, um länger zu leben?“ ... en: “Do you need to water in the morning to live longer?”... What is the best time to water plants during a heat wave? pexels As temperatures rise every day, care for potted plants grown inside the house or on the veranda has become an emergency. This is because it has become common for leaves to droop or for the soil to dry out quickly. However, I am hesitant to water at any time. Gardening experts advise that the best time to water plants is early in the morning. The ideal time is between 6 a.m. and 10 a.m. in spring and summer.
